piece: Beethoven, Sonata Op. 13 Pathétique, II Adagio cantabile
whyHere: The singing slow-movement model: 8-bar theme, return an octave higher, denser left hand.
notes: First 8 bars of the theme. The next 8 in the piece are this period again +8va (arrangement lift). Our 16-bar period inserts a B we do not sketch here. The tune's top voice attacks about 3.2 times a 2/4 bar at MIDI 66: `flowing`, sung. (An earlier count of 10.5 onsets a bar included the inner sixteenth murmur the right hand plays under the tune; that was the metric, not the music.)
